note: Pairwise facts live here, not inside plant files. Same claim rules apply (source, context, confidence, status). Model placeholders are retired when a sourced relation covers the same pair and type (R10/M10); the rest keep verify_against and list the sourced claims that bear on them (supporting_claims).

relations.text: A practising designer listed Vaccinium ovatum and Gaultheria shallon together in a five-plant list for Metro Vancouver, both as evergreen natives.
relations.context: survey d1, same respondent list (with Gaillardia aristata, Eriophyllum lanatum, Campanula rotundifolia)

practitioner_meta.observer_background: MLA student and practising landscape designer; studio, professional and personal-garden experience

relations.note: co-listing is weak evidence of compatibility — it records that a designer thinks of them together, nothing more

relations.text: Vaccinium ovatum and Gaultheria shallon co-occur naturally in coastal PNW conifer understory and are commonly planted together as an evergreen native shrub layer (model placeholder, unverified).

E-Flora BC places both Vaccinium ovatum and Gaultheria shallon in coastal lowland to montane forest of the Coastal Western Hemlock zone — the same habitat classes, so they co-occur naturally in the Vancouver region.
relations.context: derived: overlapping habitat classes on the two atlas pages (forest, lowland, montane, coastal; modal zone CWH); the source does not state the association itself
relations.citation: In Klinkenberg, Brian. (Editor) 2020. E-Flora BC: Electronic Atlas of the Plants of British Columbia [eflora.bc.ca]. Lab for Advanced Spatial Analysis, Department of Geography, University of British Columbia, Vancouver. [Accessed: 2026-10-29]
relations.note: habitat co-occurrence, not a planting-design recommendation; the model placeholder m1 says the same from general knowledge and is retired by this claim

relations.text: Once established, Gaultheria shallon can spread into and under Vaccinium ovatum; the huckleberry usually holds its own because it is taller, but smaller plantings can be overrun (model placeholder, unverified).
relations.note: most valuable relation to confirm with a practitioner. Sourced claims now establish the mechanism (suckering/rhizomatous, forms thickets — RHS, OSU, USDA) but no source states the effect on huckleberry specifically.

relations.text: Gaultheria shallon is often used as an evergreen groundcover beneath Acer palmatum; both accept filtered shade and acidic soil (model placeholder, unverified).
relations.note: mechanism supported piecewise (MOBOT: maple as sun-dappled understory/woodland-margin tree; RHS/E-Flora: salal in shade; both on acidic soil) but no source describes the pairing — stays a placeholder

relations.text: Vaccinium ovatum can form the shrub layer under a small Acer palmatum canopy; the maple's shallow roots and the huckleberry's slow establishment both argue for planting the shrub first (model placeholder, unverified).
relations.note: huckleberry's slow establishment now sourced (USDA slow; RHS 10–20 yr); shade tolerance sourced (GPP); the pairing itself is not — stays a placeholder

outside_db.note: named companions are not in the db; recorded here so they are not lost. Polystichum munitum (survey candidate) would make this a relation.
